title: hypolepis rugosula var. poeppigii

The plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties to help in wound healing, as well as acting as a diuretic to aid in urinary tract issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant, although not extensively studied, are likely to include various compounds such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins that contribute to its medicinal properties.
